preconditions.description: Input contains at least two lines: the first line is N (number of nodes), and the second line is the linked list representation.
The integer N on the first line equals the count of node values in the linked list on the second line.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(v) <= 10**5 for v in values)
preconditions.description: Every node value in the linked list is an integer between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.
The number of nodes N is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is the level order traversal of the constructed complete binary tree, which matches the input sequence because the input list already represents the tree in level order (index i maps to children 2*i+1 and 2*i+2).
